snippet.title: Adorable Adventures - Announce trailer
snippet.description:
Follow Boris, a curious baby boar, on a cozy journey through a handcrafted forest. After a wildfire, Boris must learn to use his nose to reunite with his family.

Adorable Adventures is a third-person exploration game with a unique and deep scent-tracking mechanic, ambient soundscapes, and a heartfelt story told by a Forest Guard.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: steampowered.com/app/3840230/ 📦 Presskit: https://impress.games/press-kit/wild-sheep-studio/adorable-adventures 🐾 Captured 100% in-engine

✨ Features:
• Be as adventurous and playful as Boris, a baby boar
• A deep and innovative scent-tracking mechanic
• An interactive herbarium to complete
• Interact with your brothers and sisters and other wildlife
• A collection of playful activities to compete in
• An adaptive story told in voice-over
• Playful blend of exploration, light platforming and discovery
• Made with care by a small, passionate indie team in the south of France

🛠️ Software used to make this:
- Unreal Engine 5
- Blender
- Houdini
- Reaper
- Wwise

We’re Wild Sheep Studio—a small indie team making relaxing and fun games for everyone. Join for our Adorable Adventures and explore what goes into creating relaxing worlds from scratch.

🎬 Dive deeper into our process:
Making a Forest - https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL6EDym14r4PAcaa9lNtoUhsIUcRVTq9Ts&si=bwJk1Vuq8Ra3tddV
Life at the studio - https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL6EDym14r4PBmw_zVic5Gv01Vs-RJGV8m&si=58FpmqOAbfhH3FAG
Behind the scenes - https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL6EDym14r4PAjchugyOaYwgz9Rp9DYCst&si=KwURgdQhMJ-KrjXd
